title: The architecture of blockchain value: capabilities, pillars, and growth dynamics: replication package
description: Replication package for the paper published in Frontiers in Blockchain 9:1747512 (2026). The paper classifies blockchains into single-, multi- and meta-capability paradigms, describes five architectural pillars (purpose, consensus, incentives, tokenomics, network effects) and proposes a stylized valuation model in which network value depends on adoption, per-unit service value and pairwise complementarities between capabilities. Includes the model as a Python module, the scripts that draw Figures 5 and 8, the numbers stated in Section 3, the drawing code of the six diagrams, the paradigm tables in machine-readable form and a single-page interactive demo (https://apapadogiannis.github.io/architecture-of-blockchain-value/).
